verdict.rationale: Whether a meeting-transcription SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, since open-source meeting assistants exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an open license or a public source repository for Fireflies. The API docs, MCP server and example code snippets do not make the product's own source readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
